purpose: Broaden evidence for adaptation benefits, real large-model support and standard multivariate test protocols

benchmark.features: M: all 7 ETT or 8 exchange targets
benchmark.scaling: training-only mean and population standard deviation per column
benchmark.reporting: all runs, mean and sample std across seeds, paired improvements versus base, per-target and per-lead errors
benchmark.selection: validation only; test never selects seeds, runs or checkpoints
benchmark.pass_criteria: complete reproducible protocol and independent label/metric verification; improvements not required

large_models.real_data: pinned ETTh1 slice, two targets and four covariate types, missing history, L63/H41
large_models.limits: functional/shape support only; no large-model quality, throughput, long training or maximum-context capacity claims

frozen_transfer_extension.preprocessing: target training-only scaler and target column layout, array interface; source weights only
frozen_transfer_extension.purpose: Separate within-dataset adaptation gains from frozen cross-dataset transfer and expose regressions

interpretation_limits: Two domains do not establish universal industry generalization
Overlapping origins and related ETT datasets are not independent observations
Three seeds characterize training variation, not statistical significance
Matched test protocols do not imply identical pretraining, training budgets or losses
DLinear uses the official network with an explicit local training loop and documented validation-loader difference
